mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing the present value of expected returns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% in a single month signals tightening monetary policy, raising the cost of capital and compressing discount rates, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, lowering risk premia and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.0% in a single month signals a sharp tightening in labor supply, raising risk premia and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 for 3 consecutive months indicates strengthening domestic demand, lowering discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 236 for 3 consecutive months indicates a cooling inflationary pressure, reducing policy uncertainty and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in cooling periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly rise in both industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (HOUST) above their respective 2017=100 indices for 3 consecutive months indicates dual demand expansion, lowering discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
